question: Alphabet 的 FY2025 10-K 披露了哪些报告分部，各自包括哪些主要业务？请提供足以回答的原始段落和完整的相关列举，保留必要限定。

facts.rationale: States the reporting structure: Google Services, Google Cloud and Other Bets, with AI R&D reported in Alphabet-level activities. The text sits in the delivered block verbatim.

citations.quote: We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets.

facts.rationale: Text matches the source, but it is a general product-history paragraph on Search and AI Overviews. It does not define a segment or its composition.

citations.quote: While Google Search started as a way to find web pages

facts.rationale: Text matches the source, but it is general narrative on digital content. It does not list segment businesses.

citations.quote: improve the discovery and creation of digital content both on the web and through platforms like Google Play and YouTube

facts.rationale: Text matches the source, but it is general narrative on platforms and devices. It does not assign them to a segment.

citations.quote: we continue to invest in platforms like our Android mobile operating system, Chrome browser

facts.rationale: This is the section heading for the revenue description. It gives provenance only.

citations.quote: How We Make Money

facts.rationale: Text matches the source. It is a general advertising-technology paragraph that does not define segment composition, so it is marginal.

citations.quote: We have built world-class advertising technologies for advertisers, agencies, and publishers

facts.rationale: Describes Google Services' primary revenue: performance and brand advertising on Search & other properties, YouTube and Google Network properties.

citations.quote: Google Services generates revenues primarily by delivering both performance and brand advertising

facts.rationale: Defines performance advertising, one of the two advertising types in Google Services.

citations.quote: Performance advertising creates and delivers relevant ads that users will click on

facts.rationale: Defines brand advertising, one of the two advertising types in Google Services.

citations.quote: Brand advertising helps enhance users' awareness of and affinity

facts.rationale: List introduction for Google Services non-advertising revenue.

citations.quote: In addition, Google Services generates revenues from products and services beyond advertising, including:

facts.rationale: List item: consumer subscriptions (YouTube services, Google One).

citations.quote: consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services

facts.rationale: List item: platforms (Google Play).

citations.quote: platforms, which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases

facts.rationale: List item: devices (Pixel family).

citations.quote: devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices.

facts.rationale: Heading for the Google Cloud section.

citations.quote: Google Cloud

facts.rationale: Describes the Google Cloud revenue model (Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace) and introduces the list of uses.

citations.quote: Through our Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace offerings, Google Cloud generates revenues primarily

facts.rationale: Google Cloud list item: AI-optimized Infrastructure.

citations.quote: AI-optimized Infrastructure: runs on our Cloud

facts.rationale: Google Cloud list item: Developer Platform (Vertex AI).

citations.quote: Developer Platform: delivers a fully managed AI development platform, through Vertex AI

facts.rationale: Google Cloud list item: Cybersecurity.

citations.quote: Cybersecurity: provides AI-powered threat intelligence

facts.rationale: Google Cloud list item: Data and Analytics.

citations.quote: Data and Analytics: enables customers to migrate, clean, prepare

facts.rationale: Parent item for the Agents sub-bullets in the Google Cloud list.

citations.quote: •Agents:

facts.rationale: Agents sub-item: Gemini Enterprise.

citations.quote: Gemini Enterprise: empowers teams to discover, create, share, and run AI agents

facts.rationale: Agents sub-item: Gemini for Google Workspace.

citations.quote: Gemini for Google Workspace: brings our AI-powered agents into Gmail, Docs, Sheets

facts.rationale: Heading for the Other Bets section.

citations.quote: Other Bets

facts.rationale: Describes Other Bets, citing X and Waymo as examples across development stages.

citations.quote: such as X, our moonshot factory

facts.rationale: Qualifies Other Bets: independent companies, early-stage, revenue primarily from autonomous transportation and internet services.

citations.quote: Revenues from Other Bets are generated primarily from the sale of autonomous transportation and internet services.

requirements.rationale: The delivered text names the reporting structure (Google Services, Google Cloud, Other Bets) and states that centralized AI R&D is reported in Alphabet-level activities. It gives the Google Services revenue composition: performance and brand advertising on Search & other, YouTube and Google Network, plus subscriptions, platforms and devices. It gives the full Google Cloud list (infrastructure, developer platform, cybersecurity, data and analytics, agents with two sub-items). It gives the Other Bets description and its qualifiers. List introductions and the "primarily" qualifiers are preserved. Some general narrative blocks are unnecessary and should be trimmed.

citations.quote: We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud
Revenues from Other Bets are generated primarily from the sale of autonomous transportation and internet services.

source_checks.rationale: The delivered original blocks cover the segment structure and the business description of each segment. Reading groups show all required list members and introductions delivered; only layout blocks (page number, running header) were excluded. No non-text gaps are listed.

citations.quote: In addition, Google Services generates revenues from products and services beyond advertising, including:

assessment.coverage_reason: The delivered original blocks answer which segments are reported and what main businesses each includes. They include the complete Google Services and Google Cloud lists with their introductions and qualifiers, and the Other Bets description. The Alphabet-level activities qualification is also present. Some general narrative blocks are surplus and should be trimmed.
revision_requests: Remove irrelevant general narrative blocks block-000088-778b3180, block-000089-eec5429f and block-000090-f900cbea; they do not describe segment composition.
Remove redundant block-000092-02c6e3d3 (generic advertising technology paragraph); the next block already covers the segment's primary revenue.

body_checks.rationale: Directly states the segments and Alphabet-level activities.
General Search/AI product history; no segment composition.
General digital-content narrative; not segment composition.
General platforms/devices narrative with no segment assignment.
Generic advertising-technology paragraph; the segment's revenue sources are covered by the following blocks.
Explains the performance advertising component of Google Services.
Explains the brand advertising component of Google Services.
List introduction for the non-advertising revenue list.
Cloud revenue description and list introduction.
Parent item for the Agents sub-bullets.
Other Bets qualifiers and revenue sources.

limitations: Block 096 (a non-list paragraph between the advertising bullets and 'In addition') was not delivered. It is not part of the reading groups and its content was not reviewed; it is probably not needed for the answer.
Layout-only blocks (page number, running header) were excluded; this does not affect the content.
